sentences.text:
The petitioner has further filed an application under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure against the opposite party being Misc. Case No. 850 of 2024 and is pending before the Family Court,
Asansol, district - Paschim Bardhaman.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the husband/opposite party herein is contesting the aforesaid proceeding at Asansol.
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of this application upon the opposite party/husband by registered post with Acknowledgement Due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date.

There shall be an order of stay of all further proceedings in Matrimonial Suit No. 1439 of 2023 pending before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track, Second Court at Howrah till the end of June, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
